# Vertical SaaS Radar

> Evidence-linked product intelligence for scheduling, CRM, messaging and automation SaaS.

## Product
- [Home](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/): Public radar dashboard and current brief.
- [Markdown overview](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/index.md): Clean text version of the product page.
- [Glossary](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/glossary): Product-intelligence terminology used by the radar.
- [OpenAPI](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/openapi.json): Read-only HTTP API contract.

## Data
- [Latest brief](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/api/brief): Current machine-readable brief.
- [Source registry](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/api/sources): Public monitored source catalog.
- [Sitemap](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/sitemap.md): Human- and agent-readable site map.

## Optional
- [Full context](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded architecture, scoring and usage context.
- [Agent guide](https://vertical-saas-radar.onrender.com/AGENTS.md): Installation, configuration, usage and examples for coding agents.
